modules.name: VPC (multi-AZ)
modules.description: Standard VPC with public, private-app, and private-db subnets across az_count AZs (default 2; from META dr_availability.availability_zones / az_count)

modules.name: ECS Fargate
modules.description: ECS cluster + Fargate service + ALB + ECR + CloudWatch logs

modules.name: Lambda + API Gateway
modules.description: Lambda function + HTTP API Gateway (IAM/JWT auth, never anonymous) + CloudWatch logs + artifact S3 bucket ({app_id lowercased}-artifacts-{account}-{region}); CI uploads the function package there and deploys it with update-function-code --publish (Terraform ignores code drift)

modules.name: EC2 (ASG + ALB, AMI-based)
modules.description: Launch template from a parameterized AMI (AWS MGN-launched / golden AMI; no containers) + Auto Scaling group in private subnets + ALB/target group with health check + security groups + IAM instance profile (SSM, CloudWatch agent, artifact-bucket read) + artifact S3 bucket + CloudWatch log group and CPU/unhealthy-host/5xx alarms

modules.name: RDS / Aurora
modules.description: RDS instance (postgres/mysql) or Aurora cluster (aurora-postgresql/aurora-mysql) from target_database; instance class + multi_az vars; KMS-encrypted storage; master credentials managed in Secrets Manager (manage_master_user_password); private DB subnets; SG limited to the app tier

modules.name: DynamoDB Table
modules.description: DynamoDB table with optional GSI, encryption, PITR, TTL

modules.name: S3 Bucket
modules.description: S3 bucket with versioning, encryption, lifecycle, public access blocked

modules.name: CodePipeline (CodeCommit → CodeBuild → ECS | CodeDeploy | Lambda)
modules.description: AWS CodePipeline with CodeCommit source (repo default branch) and CodeBuild running the committed cicd/buildspec.yml (tests + coverage gate); deploy by target_compute: ecs_fargate → ECS deploy action, ec2 → CodeDeploy in-place one-at-a-time behind the ALB, lambda → CodeBuild update-function-code --publish; EventBridge-triggered on push
